statement: Fix β > 1 and 0 ≤ γ < 1. Using the same independent standard Gaussian couplings as in (1.1), define the exponent 6 and log partition function HCW n (σ; β, γ) = β √ n X 1≤i<j≤n gijσiσj + γ 2n n X i=1 σi !2 , FCW n (β, γ) = log X σ∈{−1,1}n eHCW n (σ;β,γ) . Here γ is the ferromagnetic coupling already in the exponent. As n → ∞ through all integers, Var FCW n (β, γ) ∼ a2(β)n1/3 , FCW n (β, γ) − EFCW n (β, γ) q Var FCW n (β, γ) =⇒ νβ. Here a2(β) > 0 is the constant a2 above at the same β. The centering and standard deviation are the perturbed model’s own exact finite-size quantities.
